gloss: hundreds; several hundred; how many hundreds

definitions.explanation: An indefinite expression for an unspecified number in the hundreds. Typically used with も to emphasize how many there are.

examples.japanese: {何百|なんびゃく}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
{何百|なんびゃく}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a building from hundreds of years ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何百|なんびゃく}⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Hundreds of old books are kept in this library.

notes:
Combines ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧/⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (how many; what) + ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundred). The ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ voices to びゃく after ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧. Almost always appears with a counter and the particle ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ to mean "hundreds of..."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何百|なんびゃく}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: hundreds of people
- {何百|なんびゃく}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: hundreds of years ago
- {何百|なんびゃく}⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: hundreds of times
- {何百|なんびゃく}⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: hundreds of (books)
- {何百|なんびゃく}⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧: several million yen (lit. "hundreds of ten-thousand yen")

QUESTION USE:
Without ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧, {何百|なんびゃく}〜? can also ask "how many hundreds?": {何百|なんびゃく}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？ — "How many hundreds of people came?" — but the "hundreds of" reading is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何千|なんぜん}: thousands of
- {何万|なんまん}: tens of thousands of
- {何十|なんじゅう}: tens of, dozens of
